Class GameInitializer

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.model.GameInitializer
public class GameInitializer extends Object
Responsible for initializing all game components at the start of a match.

Each method loads data from a JSON resource file and returns the corresponding collection ready for use by the game engine. The size and composition of each collection depend on the number of players.

  • Method Details

    • initDeck

      public List<Card> initDeck(int numPlayers)
      Initializes and returns the main card deck for the given number of players.

      Cards are loaded from /json/tribes.json and trimmed to the appropriate deck size. They are then split by age, shuffled within each age, and reassembled in order (age 1 → age 2 → age 3 → final events).

      Parameters:
      numPlayers - number of players in the match (2–5)
      Returns:
      the shuffled deck ordered by age; an empty list if numPlayers is invalid or the resource cannot be loaded

    • initBuildingDeck

      public List<Card> initBuildingDeck(int numPlayers)
      Initializes and returns the building card deck for the given number of players.

      Cards are loaded from /json/buildings.json, shuffled within each age, and trimmed to the number of buildings appropriate for the player count.

      Parameters:
      numPlayers - number of players in the match (2–5)
      Returns:
      the selected building cards ordered by age; an empty list if numPlayers is invalid or the resource cannot be loaded

    • initQueue

      public List<Tile> initQueue(int numPlayers)
      Initializes and returns the tile queue for the given number of players.

      Tiles are loaded from /json/qtiles.json and filtered by ID range according to the player count. The result is returned as a LinkedList to support efficient removal from the front.

      Parameters:
      numPlayers - number of players in the match (2–5)
      Returns:
      the tile queue as a LinkedList; an empty list if numPlayers is invalid or the resource cannot be loaded

    • initBoard

      public ArrayList<Tile> initBoard(int numPlayers)
      Initializes and returns the game board tiles for the given number of players.

      Tiles are loaded from /json/tiles.json, filtered to include only those whose minimum player requirement is met, and sorted by ID.

      Parameters:
      numPlayers - number of players in the match (2-5)
      Returns:
      the board tiles sorted by ID; an empty list if numPlayers is invalid or the resource cannot be loaded

    • initUpperList

      public List<Card> initUpperList(List<Card> deck, List<Card> buildings, List<Card> upperList, int numPlayers)
      Populates the upper card list by drawing from the deck and the building deck.

      Cards are drawn from deck until the upper list reaches numPlayers + 4 entries, then a fixed number of building cards (depending on numPlayers) are appended.

      Parameters:
      deck - the main card deck to draw from; modified in place
      buildings - the building card deck to draw from; modified in place
      upperList - the list to populate; modified in place
      numPlayers - number of players in the match (2–5)
      Returns:
      the populated upperList; an empty list if numPlayers is invalid

    • initLowerList

      public List<Card> initLowerList(List<Card> deck, List<Card> upperList, int numPlayers)
      Populates and returns the lower card list by drawing from the deck.

      Cards are drawn one at a time until the lower list reaches numPlayers + 1 entries. Event cards encountered during drawing are redirected to upperList rather than added to the lower list.

      Parameters:
      deck - the main card deck to draw from; modified in place
      upperList - the upper list, which receives any event cards drawn; modified in place
      numPlayers - number of players in the match
      Returns:
      the populated lower list; an empty list if the deck is empty
